content:
leo_sales: Hey team — Fortuna Health wants to run a fully air-gapped POC. Model footprint ~300GB, target on-prem inference (no internet). They asked about packaging strategy, upgrade cadence, activation/licensing, and any enterprise blockers. What do we need to surface?

tara_se: Technically doable. Main points: initial transport (sneakernet / secure transfer), chunked installers with resume, and node resource sizing. Recommend: bootstrap image (~20GB) + content-addressed chunked deltas for model weights.

jin_ops: +1. For transfer: we support multipart bundles with manifest-v2 and resumable chunks. Prefer rsync/HTTP with range support for reliability. We also provide a small agent that validates and assembles chunks locally. Example verify command:```sha256sum -c bundle.manifest || echo \"corrupt\"```

anita_sec: Security side: bundles must be signed (ECDSA), include SBOM (CycloneDX), and have an accompanying attestations file. We need to provide a verify script customers can run offline. Also need guidance on key rotation for long-lived on-prem installs.

leo_sales: Good. They also asked about upgrade cadence — they want quarterly security patches but monthly model tweaks. Can we support mixed cadence?

tara_se: Yes. Strategy: baseline kernel/install (quarterly), model deltas (monthly). We ship cumulative quarterly installers and smaller monthly deltas (chunked). For tight windows we can also do a hot-patch delta that only replaces quantized weights — minimal downtime.

jin_ops: Operational constraints: server disk needs ~1.2x model size during install for staging+apply. So for 300GB model expect ~360GB free during update. If nodes are constrained, we can support in-place streaming apply but it carries higher risk.

anita_sec: Licensing/activation: offline activation via signed license token generated by us and encrypted with customer's public KMS key (they provide public key). Alternatively we can ship an HSM-backed license file that they drop into /etc/redwood/license and the agent verifies signature locally.

leo_sales: Pricing note for the customer: offline packaging + bespoke delta pipeline is an engineering effort. Propose: one-time packaging fee + monthly maintenance for delta generation + standard usage licensing for the POC. I can follow up with a rough SOW. :moneybag:

jin_ops: Build pipeline note: we produce immutable bundles with manifest.json entries like:
```json
{
  \"bundle_version\": \"0.9.1\",
  \"chunks\": 482,
  \"manifest_sha256\": \"3f7e9c2a...\"
}
```
Deploy-bot will post artifacts once built.

deploy-bot: Artifact built: offline-bundle-0.9.1.tar.gz; manifest_sha256=3f7e9c2ab9d1e6f0a4b2c9f3d7e5a6b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7

anita_sec: I'll run through their security questionnaire section on offline installs (SBOM, signing, attestation, key management) and respond by EOD tomorrow. Need sample SBOM and verify script to attach. :spiral_calendar: :eyes:

leo_sales: Thanks — can we target a first-pass bundle and delta plan in 10 business days? If yes I'll put that in the SOW and sync with the customer's onboarding team.

tara_se: 10 days is tight but doable if we reuse existing bundle tooling and the customer provides a transfer window. Need confirmation on: transport method, destination host specs (disk/ram/GPUs), and customer's KMS public key.

leo_sales: I'll ask for those items now.

jin_ops: For record, unblockers:
 - transfer medium availability (tape/usb/secure courier)
 - host disk >= 1.2x model size
 - customer KMS public key or HSM access pattern
 - agreed upgrade SLA (downtime window)

anita_sec: And compliance asks: data flow diagram for on-prem inference, retention policy for logs, and audit log export process.

leo_sales: Great. I'll capture action items and update the customer. :thumbsup:
